'''Horizon Outpost''' was a military base established by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] at the southern end of the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle for the Black Hole|battle for the area]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial base in the Black Hole Daily Area, Horizon Outpost was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
